experiment.first_release: First two frozen layouts:12 branches and one complete table, before executing remaining12 branches
experiment.complete_policy_runs: old/new on each of four layouts:8 runs, matched sensor/start/budget/execution contract

shared: acquired prefix and all past frames
single_change_requirement.vary: Observation acquisition-gain estimator only:paper visibility surrogate versus prediction-only virtual-camera/TSDF acquisition forecast
single_change_requirement.prohibited_confound: No conditional-mean collapse or changed surface quadrature applied to just one estimator; no candidate filtering or weight changes hidden as engineering.

surface_evaluation.reference: Fixed source-surface samples and sampling area weights, evaluation-only; frozen before branch outcomes
surface_evaluation.native_mesh: Actual measured-only TSDF; no predicted surface fusion or alignment
surface_evaluation.point_pairing: Use identical fixed reference points for prefix and every candidate endpoint. Gross minus lost equals net, exactly before rounding.

state_rows: old selected measured object gross area
new selected measured object gross area
best observed area among three candidates
old and new gap from candidate best
primary_table.layout_rows: Equal mean over both predeclared states, retain both state rows in source data; independent unit is layout, not branch or repeated state.
secondary: 95/100 coverage action and return outcome for complete policies

prior_ablation: Compute both neutral and category priors under each estimator on the exact same three executed candidates. Keep all four selected routes and their actual outcomes; broader unexecuted-candidate winners must be marked as lacking an actual outcome.

failure_accounting.no_native_endpoint: Use missing/null area, never invented zero. Report the missing candidate and best-area incompleteness.
failure_accounting.partial_native_endpoint: Evaluate observed partial area but label partial; candidate-best value is only best observed, not a guarantee of full-route optimum.
failure_accounting.complete_policy_run: Only a finalized result plus valid artifact manifest is complete. A partial100% coverage heartbeat is not a completed matched run.

claim_boundaries: Four constructed layouts and two topology families are controlled synthetic cases, not four natural environments.
Exact pose/ideal visible labels do not validate natural recognition or SLAM accuracy.
Better area MAE, better candidate ranking, larger selected object surface, coverage efficiency and whole-scene F1 are distinct outcomes.
The candidate oracle is limited to the three attempted controlled routes, not all physical routes or future policies.

short_candidate_design.rule: On original native routes and before reading prediction gains or outcome truth, choose the largest outbound-action cost band of width3actions; ties choose lower band then lower ordered candidate IDs. Require at least3 routes. Rank old/new S within that shared cost-matched pool, retain both selected routes and fill to3 by ascending original candidate ID. Re-rank neutral/semantic priors on that final shared3 for all matched diagnostics.
short_candidate_design.winner_definition: Actual maximizer in this declared controlled short-replay pool, not a claim to be the winner over every original full-run route.
short_candidate_design.best_area_definition: Best actual gross-new object area among the3 executed short branches; not global-optimal or best-over-unexecuted route evidence.
short_candidate_design.infeasible_band: Keep as protocol preparation failure with route costs; do not replace states/layouts using outcomes. No widening after gains.
short_candidate_design.full_policy: The controlled cost band is used only for short replay; complete runs keep all original native candidates.
